pattern: ^\[Win32App\]\[V3Processor\] A restart is required to continue processing apps\. Stop processing\.
description: Detects IME aborting app processing because an app requires a restart ('A restart is required to continue processing apps. Stop processing.', SideCarV3AppProcessor.cs). Postpones the current app: remaining apps do nothing until after the reboot, which previously looked like an unexplained stall mid-ESP.
